summary: Iteration 135: Bug fixes for Loan Given repayment feature verified. All 11 backend tests PASSED. ✓ Bug Fix 2 (Backend investments.py line 791): loan-detail uses 'or' pattern: `outstanding = inv.get('outstandingAmount') or principal` - handles both missing key AND null value
✓ Bug Fix 2 (Backend investments.py line 583): add-repayment uses 'or' pattern: `outstanding = inv.get('outstandingAmount') or inv.get('principal', 0) or 0`
✓ Bug Fix 3 (Backend investments.py lines 34-52): expectedAmount calculation for income source now uses installment plan logic with interest fraction
✓ Test 01-02: Repayment accepts positive and decimal numeric values
✓ Test 03-05: loan-detail returns correct outstanding - equals principal for fresh loan, falls back to principal when null/0
✓ Test 06-07: Income source created with expectedAmount > 0 for loans with interest (both agreedReturnAmount and returnRate methods)
✓ Test 08: Repayment returns interestPortion and principalPortion > 0 for loans with interest
✓ Test 09: Repayment creates income_received entry when interest portion > 0
✓ Test 10-11: Validation still works - negative/oversized amounts rejected with 400
